skills.name: Wheelchair transfer
skills.summary: A caregiver uses a transfer belt to safely assist a patient from lying in a bed to sitting in a wheelchair.
safety_criteria: Both wheelchair brakes and bed wheels remain locked throughout the transfer.
The caregiver uses a wide stance, bends at the knees, and keeps a straight back without twisting.
The patient wears non-skid shoes and is supported by the transfer belt rather than pulled by the arms.
The caregiver monitors the patient for dizziness, pain, or unsteadiness during sitting and standing.
The patient's legs touch the front of the wheelchair before lowering into the seat.

steps.title: Perform routine preparation and greet patient
steps.description: The caregiver washes hands, provides privacy, greets the patient, explains the transfer, and checks the ID band to ensure safe, informed care.

visual_cues: The caregiver stands at the sink washing hands.
The caregiver pulls the privacy curtain and approaches the bedside.
fail_criteria: The caregiver skips handwashing before touching the patient.
The caregiver fails to provide privacy or explain the procedure.
The caregiver does not verify the patient's identity.
pass_criteria: The caregiver washes hands at the sink before approaching the bed.
The caregiver closes the privacy curtain or door.

steps.title: Position the wheelchair alongside the bed
steps.description: The caregiver places the wheelchair next to the bed facing the foot or head so the transfer path is short and direct.

visual_cues: The caregiver wheels the wheelchair into the room and parks it beside the bed.
fail_criteria: The wheelchair is placed too far from the bed, requiring the patient to walk.
The wheelchair is positioned facing away from the bed.
pass_criteria: The caregiver rolls the wheelchair up alongside the bed.
The wheelchair is angled close to the bed within an easy pivot distance.
unverified_when: The wheelchair placement area next to the bed is blocked or out of frame.

steps.title: Lock the wheelchair brakes
steps.description: The caregiver engages both wheel locks on the wheelchair to prevent it from rolling during the transfer.

visual_cues: The caregiver bends down beside the wheelchair wheels and presses the brake levers.
fail_criteria: The caregiver forgets to lock one or both wheelchair brakes.
The wheelchair rolls or shifts during the transfer.
pass_criteria: The caregiver pushes down or engages the brake lever on both sides of the wheelchair.
The wheelchair remains stationary when touched.
unverified_when: The caregiver's body blocks the view of the wheelchair brake levers.

steps.title: Clear the wheelchair footrests
steps.description: The caregiver folds up or swings away the wheelchair footrests so the patient does not trip while standing or sitting.

visual_cues: The caregiver reaches to the lower front of the wheelchair and swings or folds the footrests aside.
fail_criteria: The footrests are left down in the transfer path.
Only one footrest is moved out of the way.
pass_criteria: The caregiver flips up or swings away both footrests.
The space directly in front of the wheelchair seat is clear.
unverified_when: The lower front section of the wheelchair is out of frame or obscured.

steps.title: Assist patient to sit with shoes
steps.description: The caregiver checks bed locks, raises the head of the bed, supports the patient to sit with feet flat on the floor, and ensures shoes are worn.

visual_cues: The caregiver adjusts the bed head upward and helps the patient pivot to sit on the edge.
The patient puts on shoes while seated at the bedside.
fail_criteria: The caregiver pulls on the patient's arms instead of supporting the shoulders and knees.
The patient is left dangling without feet touching the floor or without shoes.
The caregiver fails to check that the bed is locked and at a safe low height.
pass_criteria: The caregiver checks that the bed wheels are locked and raises the head of the bed.
The caregiver supports the patient's shoulders and knees on a count of three to swing legs over the edge.
The patient sits at the edge of the bed with both feet flat on the floor wearing shoes.
unverified_when: The patient's feet or shoes are hidden below the frame edge.
The bed wheel locks are out of view.

steps.title: Apply the transfer belt securely
steps.description: The caregiver wraps the gait belt around the patient's waist over clothing and tightens it so two fingers fit underneath for a secure handhold.

visual_cues: The caregiver wraps a white strap around the seated patient's waist and threads the metal buckle.
fail_criteria: The belt is applied over bare skin or too high under the ribs or breasts.
The belt is left too loose or fastened incorrectly so it slips.
Excess belt strap is left dangling where it could trip someone.
pass_criteria: The caregiver places the belt around the patient's waist over clothing.
The caregiver threads the buckle properly and tucks in excess strap.
The caregiver checks the fit so two fingers fit snugly under the belt.
unverified_when: The caregiver's hands block the buckle while fastening or checking tightness.

steps.title: Instruct patient and align stance
steps.description: The caregiver explains the standing cue and aligns feet toe-to-toe and knee-to-knee with the patient to stabilize the stand.

visual_cues: The caregiver crouches slightly in front of the patient, aligning toes and knees together.
fail_criteria: The caregiver attempts to lift without giving a clear verbal signal or instructions.
The caregiver stands too far back without bracing the patient's knees and feet.
pass_criteria: The caregiver tells the patient where to place their hands and that they will stand on the count of three.
The caregiver positions their feet and knees directly against the patient's feet and knees.
unverified_when: The audio is missing or too quiet to hear the verbal instructions.
The floor and lower legs are cut off at the bottom of the frame.

steps.title: Stand, pivot, and lower into wheelchair
steps.description: The caregiver counts to three, assists the patient to stand using the belt, pivots until legs touch the wheelchair, and lowers the patient gently.

visual_cues: The caregiver and patient rise together, turn toward the wheelchair, and sit down smoothly.
fail_criteria: The caregiver lifts under the patient's arms instead of holding the transfer belt.
The caregiver twists their back instead of pivoting their feet.
The patient drops suddenly into the chair before feeling it behind their legs.
pass_criteria: The caregiver counts to three and grasps the transfer belt firmly on both sides.
The caregiver assists the patient to stand and pivot until the back of the patient's legs touch the wheelchair.
The caregiver bends at the knees and lowers the patient smoothly into the wheelchair seat.
unverified_when: The caregiver's back blocks the view of the belt grip or the patient's legs touching the chair.

steps.title: Position feet and remove belt
steps.description: The caregiver places the patient's feet onto the wheelchair footrests and unbuckles and removes the transfer belt.

visual_cues: The caregiver kneels to adjust the footrests under the patient's shoes and then unfastens the waist belt.
fail_criteria: The patient's feet are left hanging off the footrests.
The transfer belt is left buckled on the patient after the transfer is finished.
pass_criteria: The caregiver swings the footrests into place and rests both of the patient's feet on them.
The caregiver unbuckles and gently removes the transfer belt from around the patient's waist.
unverified_when: The footrests and feet are out of the bottom of the frame.

steps.title: Complete routine finishing actions
steps.description: The caregiver places the call light within reach, washes hands, and opens the privacy curtain to leave the patient safe and comfortable.

visual_cues: The caregiver hands the call cord to the seated patient, washes hands at the sink, and pulls back the curtain.
fail_criteria: The call light is left out of the patient's reach.
The caregiver leaves without washing hands.
pass_criteria: The caregiver hands the call light to the patient or places it within easy reach.
The caregiver washes hands at the sink and opens the privacy curtain.
unverified_when: The sink or call light placement is outside the camera frame.

skills.name: Sit to stand
skills.summary: A caregiver positions a seated person at the front of a chair with feet tucked back, then supports her shoulder and lower back while rocking forward to help her stand up.
safety_criteria: The caregiver maintains a wide base of support, bends their knees, and keeps a straight back without twisting throughout the transfer.
The caregiver never pulls on the patient's arms or lifts under the patient's armpits.
The patient's center of gravity stays over their feet as they rock forward and stand.
The chair remains stable and does not slide backward during the transfer.
The caregiver monitors the patient for balance, dizziness, or signs of pain or distress before releasing support.

steps.title: Move patient to front of chair
steps.description: The caregiver instructs the patient to wriggle their bottom forward to the front edge of the chair to bring their center of gravity closer to their feet.

visual_cues: The patient shifts weight side to side while sliding forward on the seat.

fail_criteria: The patient remains seated deep against the backrest before attempting to stand.
The patient scoots too far off the edge of the seat, risking a forward slide or fall.

steps.title: Position feet back hip-width apart
steps.description: The caregiver instructs and gently guides the patient to tuck their feet back toward the chair and place their legs hip-width apart for a stable base of support.

The patient's feet shift backward and separate on the floor.

The patient's knees and feet are pressed tightly together or crossed.

The caregiver gently guides the patient's lower legs if needed without forcing them.

The caregiver's body blocks the view of the patient's feet.

steps.title: Support patient's shoulder and lower back

visual_cues: The caregiver steps closer to the side of the chair and bends their knees slightly.
The caregiver's arms wrap gently in front of the patient's shoulder and behind the lower back.
fail_criteria: The caregiver hooks their hands under the patient's armpits or pulls on the patient's arms.
The caregiver stands too far away, forcing them to reach and twist their own back.
The caregiver fails to place a supporting hand on the patient's back or shoulder.

The caregiver places one hand at the front of the patient's shoulder.
The caregiver reaches their other arm around to support the patient's lower back.
unverified_when: The caregiver's hands and the patient's torso are blocked from view.
The caregiver stands between the patient and the recording device, hiding hand placement.

steps.title: Instruct patient to look forward and rock
steps.description: The caregiver instructs the patient to keep their head up, look forward, and rock forward on 'ready' and 'steady' before standing on 'stand'.

visual_cues: The caregiver holds the supporting position while speaking to the patient.
The patient lifts their head and gazes straight ahead.
fail_criteria: The caregiver initiates the stand abruptly without explaining the cue.
The patient keeps their head bowed down toward the floor while preparing to stand.
pass_criteria: The caregiver tells the patient to lift their head and look forward in the direction of movement.
The caregiver explains the verbal counting sequence ('ready, steady, stand') before initiating the lift.
unverified_when: The recording has no audio or the caregiver's speech is too quiet to hear.
The patient's head and face are obscured.

steps.title: Cue and assist patient to stand
steps.description: The caregiver counts 'ready, steady, stand' as they rock forward together, assisting the patient smoothly into an upright standing position.

visual_cues: Both the caregiver and patient rock forward together twice before rising.
The patient's hips leave the chair and straighten fully into a standing posture.
fail_criteria: The caregiver lifts the patient straight up without rocking forward first.
The caregiver bends at the waist with a rounded back instead of bending their knees.
The caregiver releases support before the patient is stable in standing.
The patient's knees buckle or they lose balance upon standing.
pass_criteria: The caregiver clearly counts 'ready, steady, stand' in rhythm with the patient's rocking.
The patient pushes off the armrests and leans forward over their feet before rising.
The caregiver keeps a straight back, bends their knees, and guides the patient smoothly to full standing.
The caregiver maintains steady support until the patient is balanced upright.
unverified_when: The audio is missing so the 'ready, steady, stand' cue cannot be verified.
The caregiver or patient moves out of frame during the rise to standing.

skills.name: Vehicle transfer
skills.summary: A caregiver assists a patient in transferring safely into and out of a car using a walker, and then from a wheelchair using a gait belt.
safety_criteria: Caregiver keeps a wide base of support and bends at the knees rather than the waist.
Patient never pulls on the caregiver's neck or the unstable car door for support.
Patient stays centered over their base of support during standing and pivoting.
Caregiver watches for signs of dizziness, pain, or leg buckling throughout the transfer.
Patient never attempts to step up into the vehicle on one leg while standing.

skills.name: Bed repositioning
skills.summary: A caregiver turns a patient onto his side in bed and supports his back, legs, and arm with pillows.
safety_criteria: Keep the resident positioned at a safe distance from the edge of the bed at all times.
Use proper body mechanics with a wide base of support and straight back when turning the resident.
Avoid pulling on the resident's limbs; support legs and arms from underneath when placing pillows.
Ensure bony prominences (knees, ankles) and the bottom shoulder/arm are cushioned and not compressed.
Leave the bed in its lowest position and the call light within the resident's reach at the end of the skill.

pass_criteria: Caregiver announces the turn and counts to three before rolling the resident.
Caregiver stands with a wide base of support and rolls the resident gently onto their left side.
Resident remains positioned at a safe distance from the edge of the bed.

steps.title: Support resident's back with a pillow

Caregiver pushes the edge of the pillow under the resident and rolls the rest of the pillow firmly against the back.
fail_criteria: Caregiver places the pillow loosely behind the back without tucking or rolling it to provide support.
Caregiver traps the privacy blanket underneath the back pillow.
pass_criteria: Caregiver moves the privacy blanket aside so it is not tucked under the pillow.
Caregiver places a pillow lengthwise behind the resident's back and tucks the inner edge down and under the back.
Caregiver rolls the outer edge of the pillow up and snugly against the resident's back.

visual_cues: The caregiver kneels on the bathroom floor holding a towel.
The caregiver wipes the tile floor next to the tub bench.
fail_criteria: The caregiver leaves water, puddles, or tripping hazards on the floor.
The caregiver skips checking or drying the floor before starting the transfer.
pass_criteria: The floor area around the tub bench and toilet is free of clutter or loose items.
The caregiver wipes the floor dry using a towel before bringing the person to the bench.
unverified_when: The bathroom floor around the tub bench is out of frame or blocked by furniture.

steps.title: Back person up to tub bench
steps.description: The caregiver guides the person to turn away from the tub bench using the walker and back up until both legs touch the bench edge.

visual_cues: The person turns around while holding the walker handles.
The person steps backward until their calves contact the tub bench.
fail_criteria: The person attempts to sit before the backs of their legs touch the bench.
The caregiver lets the person pivot without holding the walker or providing support.
pass_criteria: The person uses the walker to turn away from the tub bench.
The caregiver stays close beside or behind the person to steady them.
The person backs up until the backs of both legs touch the edge of the tub bench.
unverified_when: The person's legs and the edge of the tub bench are blocked from view by the walker or caregiver.

steps.title: Lower person onto the tub bench
steps.description: The caregiver helps the person reach back for the bench seat with one hand, slowly lowers them to a seated position, and moves the walker aside.

visual_cues: The person reaches one hand behind them toward the bench while the other grips the walker.
The caregiver pulls the walker away after the person sits.
fail_criteria: The person drops or falls onto the bench without controlled support.
The person lets go of the walker with both hands before reaching the seat.
The walker is left blocking the person's legs after they sit down.
pass_criteria: The person reaches back to grasp the tub bench seat with one hand while keeping the other hand on the walker.
The caregiver supports the person as they lower slowly onto the bench.
The caregiver moves the walker out of the way once the person is seated.
unverified_when: The person's hands or the bench seat are obscured by the caregiver's body.

steps.title: Move person's legs into the tub
steps.description: The caregiver instructs the person to turn toward the tub, hold the bench handle, lift each leg over the tub rim, and scoot toward the center.

visual_cues: The person grips the metal handle on the tub bench.
The person swings each leg over the edge of the bathtub and scoots inward.
fail_criteria: The person lifts their legs into the tub without holding onto the bench handle or caregiver.
The person remains perched on the outer edge of the bench instead of moving toward the center.
pass_criteria: The person turns toward the tub and grasps the bench handle for stability.
The person lifts one leg at a time over the tub rim into the tub.
The person slides toward the center of the tub bench while the caregiver steadies them.
unverified_when: The tub rim and the person's feet are out of frame.

steps.title: Remove the transfer belt
steps.description: The caregiver unbuckles and removes the transfer belt once the person is safely centered on the tub bench.

visual_cues: The caregiver reaches around the person's waist to unfasten the belt buckle.
The caregiver pulls the white belt away from the person.
fail_criteria: The caregiver removes the transfer belt before the person is safely seated and centered inside the tub.
The caregiver pulls the belt roughly, causing the person to lose balance.
pass_criteria: The caregiver unbuckles the transfer belt smoothly around the person's waist.
The transfer belt is completely removed after the person is positioned inside the tub.
unverified_when: The caregiver's hands and the buckle of the transfer belt are blocked from view.

steps.title: Move person's legs out of tub
steps.description: To exit the tub, the caregiver helps the person scoot to the bench edge, lift each leg over the rim onto the floor, and turn outward.

visual_cues: The caregiver places a hand on the person's shoulder and back as they scoot.
The person swings each leg over the tub edge onto the bathroom tile.
fail_criteria: The person attempts to stand up directly from inside the tub without swinging their legs out first.
The caregiver fails to stay close and steady the person while their legs cross the tub rim.
pass_criteria: The person scoots toward the outer edge of the tub bench.
The person lifts each leg over the tub rim and places both feet on the floor.
The person turns their body to face away from the tub while staying seated.
unverified_when: The person's legs crossing the tub rim are obscured from the camera.

steps.title: Dry floor and check non-skid footwear
steps.description: The caregiver dries the person and the floor with a towel and ensures non-skid socks or shoes are on before standing.

visual_cues: The caregiver kneels with a white towel to wipe the floor near the person's feet.
The caregiver points to or checks the person's non-skid socks.
fail_criteria: The caregiver leaves the floor wet where the person will place their feet to stand.
The person attempts to stand barefoot or in slippery socks on a wet floor.
pass_criteria: The caregiver wipes any water off the floor around the person's feet.
The person wears non-skid socks or shoes before attempting to stand.
unverified_when: The person's feet and the floor beneath them are out of frame.

steps.title: Secure the transfer belt
steps.description: The caregiver places the transfer belt around the person's waist and fastens the buckle securely before standing.

visual_cues: The caregiver fastens the buckle of the transfer belt across the person's abdomen.
The caregiver tucks in the excess strap of the belt.
fail_criteria: The transfer belt is left too loose or unbuckled.
The caregiver attempts to stand the person without putting the transfer belt back on.
pass_criteria: The caregiver wraps the transfer belt snugly around the person's waist.
The caregiver threads and locks the metal buckle securely.
unverified_when: The front of the person's waist and the belt buckle are blocked from view.

steps.title: Position walker and prepare to stand
steps.description: The caregiver places the walker in front of the person, assumes a wide stance with a straight back, and instructs the person on hand placement.

visual_cues: The caregiver brings the walker in front of the person.
The caregiver widens their stance and bends their knees while the person grips the bench edge.
fail_criteria: The caregiver bends at the waist with a rounded back or keeps their feet too close together.
The person pulls up on the walker with both hands instead of pushing off the bench with one hand.
pass_criteria: The caregiver places the walker directly in front of the seated person.
The caregiver stands close with feet shoulder-width apart, knees bent, and back straight.
The person leans forward with one hand on the walker and the other hand pushing off the tub bench.
unverified_when: The caregiver's feet or the person's hand on the bench are out of frame.

steps.title: Count and assist person to stand
steps.description: The caregiver announces the count to three, assists the person to a standing position using the transfer belt, and pauses to ensure steadiness.

visual_cues: The caregiver speaks to the person while holding the transfer belt.
The person rises to a standing position with both hands on the walker and pauses.
fail_criteria: The caregiver pulls the person up without giving a verbal cue or count.
The caregiver rushes the person into walking immediately without pausing to check balance.
pass_criteria: The caregiver tells the person it is time to stand and counts to three aloud.
The caregiver lifts with their legs while holding the transfer belt to help the person stand.
Once standing, the caregiver pauses for a few seconds to confirm the person is steady before moving.
unverified_when: The recording has no audio or the caregiver's count to three is inaudible.
The caregiver's hands on the transfer belt are blocked from view.

skills.name: Glove removal
skills.summary: A person washes their hands, puts on disposable gloves over a gown, and then removes the gloves one at a time by turning them inside-out without touching the contaminated outside surfaces with bare hands, followed by washing their hands again.
safety_criteria: Never touch the contaminated outer surface of either glove with bare skin during removal.
Always keep the hands away from the face, hair, and clothing while wearing or removing contaminated gloves.
Avoid snapping, flinging, or pulling gloves forcefully in a way that could tear them or scatter contaminants.
Always perform hand hygiene immediately before donning gloves and immediately after doffing and disposing of them.

steps.title: Perform hand hygiene before donning gloves
steps.description: The caregiver washes their hands thoroughly with soap and water to remove microorganisms before putting on gloves.

visual_cues: The caregiver stands at a sink rubbing soapy hands under running water.
fail_criteria: The caregiver skips hand hygiene and puts gloves directly onto unwashed hands.
The caregiver only splashes water on their hands without using soap or friction.
pass_criteria: The caregiver lathers both hands with soap under running water.
The caregiver rubs all surfaces of the hands and fingers together.
The caregiver rinses and dries their hands before touching clean gloves.
unverified_when: The sink or hand-washing area is outside the camera frame.
The caregiver's hands are blocked from view while washing.

steps.title: Don disposable gloves over gown cuffs
steps.description: The caregiver pulls a clean disposable glove onto each hand and extends the glove cuffs over the gown sleeves to create a complete barrier.

visual_cues: The caregiver pulls blue gloves onto each hand and adjusts the cuffs over the sleeves.
fail_criteria: The caregiver leaves bare skin or gown cuffs exposed between the glove and sleeve.
The caregiver tears or punctures a glove while putting it on and continues using it.
pass_criteria: The caregiver pulls one glove completely onto each hand with fingers seated properly.
The caregiver pulls the cuff of each glove up and over the sleeve cuff of the gown.
unverified_when: The caregiver's wrists and hands are below or outside the camera frame while pulling on the gloves.

steps.title: Pinch the first glove's outer cuff
steps.description: The caregiver uses their non-dominant gloved hand to pinch the outside of the opposite glove near the wrist cuff to begin removal without touching bare skin.

visual_cues: The caregiver brings one gloved hand to the wrist area of the other and pinches the glove material.
fail_criteria: The caregiver's fingers touch bare skin on the wrist while grabbing the cuff.
The caregiver pulls the glove from the fingertips instead of pinching near the cuff.
pass_criteria: The caregiver uses a gloved hand to pinch the outer surface of the opposite glove near the wrist cuff.
The caregiver's fingers stay on the outside of the glove and do not slip under the cuff onto bare skin or the gown.
unverified_when: The hands are turned away from the camera or blocked so the pinch point at the wrist cannot be seen.

steps.title: Peel first glove inside-out and hold
steps.description: The caregiver peels the pinched glove off inside-out and wads it into the palm of the remaining gloved hand to contain contamination.

visual_cues: One hand becomes bare while the other gloved hand closes into a fist around the removed glove.
fail_criteria: The caregiver snaps or flings the glove off, risking splatter.
The caregiver drops the removed glove or sets it on a clean surface instead of holding it.
The caregiver touches the outer surface of the remaining glove with the newly bare hand.
pass_criteria: The caregiver pulls the glove smoothly away from the hand, turning it completely inside-out.
The caregiver balls up the removed glove and holds it securely in the palm of the remaining gloved hand.
unverified_when: The caregiver's hands move out of frame while peeling or wadding the glove.

steps.title: Remove second glove inside-out from inside
steps.description: The caregiver slides a bare finger under the cuff of the remaining glove and pushes it off inside-out over the first glove so bare skin never touches the contaminated outside.

visual_cues: The bare index finger hooks under the wrist cuff of the remaining glove and pulls it down and off over the wadded glove.
fail_criteria: The caregiver touches the contaminated outer surface of the second glove with the bare hand or fingers.
The caregiver pulls the second glove off right-side-out, leaving the contaminated surface exposed.
pass_criteria: The caregiver slides the index finger of the ungloved hand carefully underneath the inside of the remaining glove's cuff.
The caregiver pushes the finger forward to peel the second glove off inside-out, enclosing the first glove inside it.
The ungloved hand touches only the clean inner surface of the glove throughout removal.
unverified_when: The caregiver's hands are blocked or out of frame when sliding the finger under the cuff.

steps.title: Dispose of the removed gloves
steps.description: The caregiver places the bundled inside-out gloves into an appropriate waste receptacle without contaminating surrounding surfaces.

visual_cues: The caregiver holds the rolled-up gloves by the inside surface and discards them.
fail_criteria: The caregiver leaves the used gloves on a counter, bed, or table.
The caregiver reaches into or touches the inside of the waste bin with bare hands.
pass_criteria: The caregiver holds only the clean inner surface of the bundled gloves.
The caregiver drops the gloves directly into a waste or biohazard receptacle.
unverified_when: The waste receptacle is outside the camera frame when the caregiver discards the gloves.

steps.title: Perform hand hygiene after glove removal
steps.description: The caregiver washes their hands with soap and water immediately after removing and discarding the gloves to eliminate any residual contamination.

visual_cues: The caregiver returns to the sink and washes bare hands with soap under running water.
fail_criteria: The caregiver skips hand hygiene after removing and disposing of the gloves.
The caregiver touches personal items, their face, or clean surfaces before performing hand hygiene.
pass_criteria: The caregiver washes all surfaces of both hands and wrists with soap and running water.
The caregiver rinses and dries their hands completely after glove removal.
unverified_when: The sink or hand-washing station is outside the camera frame.
